name: Alex
description: Alex is a university student with a limited budget. They prefer practical and affordable options. They value simplicity and portability. They dislike paying for features they will not use. They spend a lot of time studying and working on a laptop.

name: Jamie
description: Jamie is a working professional who values convenience and quality. They are willing to spend more for products that save time. They strongly value reliability and good design. They dislike complicated solutions. They frequently travel for work.

name: Morgan
description: Morgan is a software engineer who values performance and flexibility. They enjoy customizable tools, dislike unnecessary complexity, and often work across multiple devices throughout the day.

name: Taylor
description: Taylor is a teacher who prioritizes durability and ease of use. They prefer products that are reliable for everyday classroom use and avoid anything that requires constant setup or maintenance.

name: Riley
description: Riley is a freelance designer with a creative workflow. They appreciate premium aesthetics, strong brand identity, and ownership of their tools, but they resent overpriced products with weak functionality.

name: Casey
description: Casey is a recent graduate entering the workforce and is cautious with spending. They prefer budget-friendly options, clean interfaces, and products that help them stay organized without a learning curve.

name: Jordan
description: Jordan is a parent of two who values practicality and safety. They prefer products that are easy for the whole family to use and dislike anything that feels fragile or difficult to troubleshoot.

name: Skyler
description: Skyler is a marketing manager who needs quick access to collaborative tools. They value speed, communication, and polished experiences, and they dislike rigid systems that slow down campaigns.

name: Parker
description: Parker is a gamer and streamer who loves high performance and visual quality. They are willing to spend on premium gear but dislike products that underdeliver or overpromise.

name: Harper
description: Harper is a startup founder focused on growth. They value efficiency, scalability, and tools that support a busy schedule, and they avoid solutions that add unnecessary operational overhead.

name: Quinn
description: Quinn is a healthcare administrator who values reliability and compliance. They need dependable systems, clear data presentation, and easy support access, and they dislike clunky user experiences.

name: Emerson
description: Emerson is a photographer who values image quality and portability. They prefer equipment and apps that support creative work on the go and dislike anything that feels too heavy or cumbersome.

name: Avery
description: Avery is a project coordinator who likes structure and consistency. They appreciate clean workflows, excellent integration, and straightforward documentation, and they dislike confusing settings menus.

name: Blake
description: Blake is a fitness trainer who values mobility and simplicity. They prefer tools that help them stay organized and active, and they dislike products that feel unnecessary or overly complicated.

name: Cameron
description: Cameron is a college athlete with a busy schedule. They want durable, portable products that fit an active lifestyle and avoid anything that takes too much effort to maintain or carry.

name: Drew
description: Drew is a sales representative who travels often. They value convenience, battery life, and fast setup, and they dislike devices that fail in transit or require frequent charging.

name: Reese
description: Reese is a nonprofit coordinator who is cost-conscious and mission-driven. They prefer practical tools that support team collaboration and avoid premium features they do not truly need.

name: Sage
description: Sage is an interior designer with an eye for detail. They care about aesthetics, user experience, and high-quality materials, and they dislike products that look cheap or feel generic.

name: Finley
description: Finley is a data analyst who values organization and precision. They prefer tools that handle complexity cleanly, provide useful insights, and avoid interfaces that hide important information.

name: Hayden
description: Hayden is a small business owner balancing many responsibilities. They want reliable systems that save time and support growth, and they dislike tools that require too much technical support.
